title: Metamorphic testing of learned AC optimal power flow surrogates reveals representation dependence
abstract: arXiv:2611.13566v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating a learned AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF) surrogate on one grid serialization cannot show whether its accuracy depends on that encoding. We test this dependence with thirteen metamorphic relations, each specifying when a transformation is valid and how to compare its outputs. Our audit covers 17 model and pipeline configurations: two released trained checkpoints and 15 random-weight architecture or mechanism controls. Every configuration violates at least six relations, even at reporting tolerances ten times tighter or looser. For GridSFM-Open v1.1, source inspection and intermediate-tensor interventions point to an indexing bug and three noncanonical or numerically unstable preprocessing choices; a repaired checkpoint remains untested. translated_title: 对学习型交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）代理模型的蜕变测试揭示了其对表示的依赖性
translated_abstract: 在单一的电网序列化编码上评估学习型交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）代理模型，无法证明其准确性是否依赖于该编码。我们通过十三个蜕变关系来检验这种依赖性，每个关系都规定了变换何时有效以及如何比较其输出。我们的审计涵盖17种模型与流水线配置：两个已发布的训练检查点和15个随机权重的架构或机制对照组。即使将报告容差收紧或放宽十倍，每种配置仍至少违反六个蜕变关系。对于GridSFM-Open v1.1，源代码检查和中间张量干预指向一个索引错误以及三个非规范或数值不稳定的预处理选择；修复后的检查点尚未经过测试。在单独的case500训练实验中，数据增强在四个模型中的三个上降低了变换视图误差，并在所有四个模型上降低了中值差异和约束违反的P95指标（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出用十三项蜕变关系系统审计学习型交流最优潮流代理模型，发现所有被测配置均存在对输入序列化表示的依赖性，并借此定位出索引错误与不稳定预处理等缺陷，同时证明数据增强可以缓解这种表示依赖问题。
en_tdlr: This paper audits learned AC optimal power flow surrogates using thirteen metamorphic relations, revealing that all tested configurations depend on the input grid serialization, exposing indexing bugs and numerically unstable preprocessing, and demonstrating that data augmentation mitigates this representation dependence.
